rule: GOAL: Fill four slots to match a color sequence shown in a top legend. CONTROLS: Click a color tile at the bottom to select it, then click a gray slot to place it. RULE: Colors must be placed in the exact left-to-right order displayed by the colored outlines at the top. TRAP: Believing slots accept any color regardless of order wastes moves, as each placement locks a specific position.

GOAL: Fill every empty slot in the red and green boxes with the correct letter tiles from the palette to clear the level. CONTROLS: Click a palette tile to select it, then click a slot to place it. Press Space to check your solution. RULE: The hidden sequence dictates the exact order of letters across the slots, not just random matching. TRAP: Assuming you can overwrite an occupied slot with a new tile wastes time; you must undo mistakes first.

GOAL: Guide the purple node to the ball's core. CONTROLS: Click grid cells to move the node along marked paths. RULE: The node moves exactly three spaces toward the target dot per click. TRAP: Clicking the furthest visible dot wastes turns; only contiguous dots within three spaces are valid targets.

GOAL: Place seven letter tiles from the palette into matching red and green slots to complete the board. CONTROLS: Click a palette tile to select it, click an empty slot to place it, and press Space to check the solution. RULE: Letters must be arranged in a specific flattened order across the slots to form the correct word sequence. TRAP: Placing tiles in visual left-to-right order within each box fails; the global sequence determines the correct placement.

GOAL: Guide the piece across the grid to reach the designated exit tile. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the piece two spaces in the chosen direction. RULE: You must land only on white tiles, jumping over gray gaps, with black walls blocking the path. TRAP: Assuming you can step one tile at a time or stop on gray gaps wastes moves and leads to dead ends.

GOAL: Fill red and green slots to match the target word. CONTROLS: Click palette tiles to select, click slots to place. Press space to submit. RULE: Green slots must be filled before attaching the green frame to the red box. TRAP: Assuming slot coordinates stay static after attaching boxes; fill nested slots first.

GOAL: Fit the purple blob perfectly into the dashed ring socket. CONTROLS: Clicking a black cell moves the head there; the tail follows, dragging the blob. RULE: The blob always sits exactly at the midpoint between the head and tail. TRAP: Thinking the blob moves independently; it is strictly tethered to the head-tail center.

GOAL: Pour paint from the nozzle into the cup’s notch to fill it. CONTROLS: Arrows move the blue bar horizontally to redirect the falling paint; space activates the pour. RULE: The bar acts as a shelf; paint runs off its edge, so position the bar so the runoff lands in the gap. TRAP: Thinking the bar catches and holds the paint. It does not; the paint must slide off the edge to reach the target.

GOAL: Guide the plug into the socket by manipulating the gray shape. CONTROLS: Click the blue button to shift material from the top arm to the bottom arm. RULE: The total mass of the gray shape remains constant; shrinking the top extends the bottom. TRAP: Do not assume the shape translates or rotates as a whole unit, as this leads to incorrect positioning.

GOAL: Arrange five red shapes and a three-item blue container to match a nine-slot target sequence. CONTROLS: Drag shapes to slots; press space to confirm the solution. RULE: The blue container’s contents must appear twice in the final order, creating a repeating three-item pattern. TRAP: Assuming the container appears only once; it actually fills two separate red slots simultaneously.

GOAL: Align the yellow plug and socket by toggling the correct marks to match their pattern. CONTROLS: Click the horizontal bar to toggle the top mark; click the vertical stem to toggle the bottom mark. RULE: Only the middle mark matches the target configuration, so ignore the outer marks. TRAP: Assuming all marks are interactive wastes time; only specific hit zones respond to clicks.

GOAL: Arrange three colored frames and six matching tiles inside nested boxes to match a hidden target sequence. CONTROLS: Click to select items, click to place them, and press Space to verify the final arrangement. RULE: The target sequence order is revealed by the pre-filled starting tiles in each inner box. TRAP: Assuming frames can be placed in any order wastes time; you must deduce the exact nesting order from the visible clues.

GOAL: Arrange nested boxes so the flattened sequence matches the target colors. CONTROLS: Click to place items into slots; press space to confirm the solution. RULE: Nesting depth determines order: inner items appear between the outer box's side items. TRAP: Assuming boxes are separate rather than nested inside one another led to failed arrangements.

GOAL: Slide the plug to the right to align with the target marker. CONTROLS: Click the button below the middle bar to move the plug right. RULE: Each click extends the upper arm left while retracting the lower arm right. TRAP: The top button moves the plug left, which is the opposite of what you need.

GOAL: Move the player to the north exit while avoiding the red enemy. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player one step in that direction. RULE: The enemy attacks horizontally if you are two spaces away in the same row. TRAP: Thinking moving into the enemy's cell was safe; it was fatal.

GOAL: Place all three sockets into the vertical tube. CONTROLS: Arrows move the player and drag the attached socket; Space picks up or drops the socket. RULE: The socket always occupies the cell directly behind the player, following every movement. TRAP: Thinking the socket is a wall blocking the player; it is not, so moving toward it just slides both forward.

GOAL: Align all three plugs simultaneously by adjusting their edge positions. CONTROLS: Clicking buttons shifts the edge of one arm while inversely shifting the adjacent arm. RULE: Only the final aligned state matters; intermediate plug positions are irrelevant to the win condition. TRAP: Believing each plug must be aligned sequentially rather than allowing temporary misalignment during adjustment.

GOAL: Match five pink symbols to blue targets while aligning their rotations. CONTROLS: Arrows move the cursor; Up rotates the pink dial at that column. RULE: A correct symbol only appears with a rotation matching the blue target’s angle. TRAP: Assuming rotation and symbol are independent; fixing rotation first might hide the correct symbol.

GOAL: Guide the plug head into the socket by sliding the connector piece left. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the small piece two grid steps at a time within the gray channel. RULE: The pattern button extends the gray path, revealing the movable connector piece inside. TRAP: The piece jumps two spaces per press, not one, causing overshoots if you count steps loosely.

ESTABLISHED: The pipe extends right and retracts left, dragging blocks until they collide. Blocks stop when hitting obstacles or each other. The win state likely requires the pipe to pass through the gaps of all three blocks aligned in a row. FAILED: Leaving the pipe extended while blocks are misaligned. Assuming blocks pass through each other. GOAL IS NOT: Simply retracting the pipe fully. CONTROLS: Up/Down moves the base. Right extends the pipe. Left retracts the pipe, pulling hooked blocks.

GOAL: Match the yellow sequence by rotating dials to align glyphs with the target poses. CONTROLS: Arrow keys rotate the selected dial; other keys switch the active dial. RULE: Each dial cycles through specific symbols, but only one rotation matches the target’s exact orientation. TRAP: Assuming symbol identity was enough; ignoring the specific pose led to wasted rotations on correct symbols in wrong orientations.

GOAL: Activate the three specific cells in the pattern to open the bottom socket. CONTROLS: Click grid cells to toggle their color; arrows move the view or piece. RULE: The center cell acts as a master switch; it must be active for other cells to stay lit. TRAP: Clicking cells before activating the center switch causes them to flash and revert, wasting time.

GOAL: Place three diamonds so their average lands exactly on the target hub. CONTROLS: Click a diamond to move it to a new spot, swapping positions with whatever was there. RULE: The hub always forms at the average center of the three diamonds. TRAP: Thinking you can place diamonds anywhere; they must stay on valid spots or the hub fails.

GOAL: Guide the player to the exit by jumping over enemies and terrain. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player two spaces in the pressed direction. RULE: You must jump over exactly one cell to move; landing on an enemy destroys it. TRAP: Believing you can only jump over gaps; jumping over walls is also allowed and often necessary.

GOAL: Decode the bottom Y-row using the top cipher rules to fill the seven-slot S-row. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the cursor to select glyphs and confirm choices. RULE: Each Y-word maps to a specific S-word; their combined slot counts must equal seven. TRAP: Assuming every glyph is a single word caused tokenization errors; some Y-glyphs form multi-word phrases.

GOAL: Transform seven source symbols into target symbols using a two-step chain. CONTROLS: Arrow keys cycle through symbol options on each of the seven dials. RULE: Apply the source-to-middle rule, then the middle-to-target rule, to find the correct setting. TRAP: Searching for a direct source-to-target rule wastes time; you must follow the two intermediate steps.

GOAL: Guide the piece to the gate using the fewest moves. CONTROLS: Arrows slide the piece; pressing the pattern triggers a hidden effect. RULE: Pressing only works when the piece is directly adjacent to the target. TRAP: Believing presses teleport pieces globally wastes turns; they require precise local alignment.

GOAL: Align the blue and yellow crosses so their arms cover all matching colored dots. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the selected cross in three-cell steps; Space switches between crosses. RULE: Crosses only cover dots when their center aligns with the geometric intersection of shared rows or columns. TRAP: Believing the cross must stay fully on-screen; clipping at the border is allowed and required for some targets.

GOAL: Match the green plus to its hollow target slot. CONTROLS: Click a plus to select it, then click the target to place it. RULE: A plus only fits into a matching empty shape outline. TRAP: Do not click empty cells randomly; only interact with pluses and their specific targets.

GOAL: Identify overlapping colored shapes and move them to their matching target zones. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active selection; Space cycles focus between different objects. RULE: Select an object to move it, ensuring you cycle Space to switch targets when shapes overlap or occlude each other. TRAP: Assuming arrow keys move the player character; they actually move the currently selected puzzle piece.

GOAL: Match the active panel's pattern to its legend by toggling cells. CONTROLS: Click grid cells to switch their color. RULE: The framed panel's legend defines the required final state. TRAP: Assuming the legend is decorative rather than the target pattern.

GOAL: Slide the active plug into the socket ring to complete the connection. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the active piece; clicking a piece makes it active. RULE: Only the piece with the white center responds to arrow keys. TRAP: Assuming both pieces move together wastes moves; you must click to switch control.

GOAL: Navigate the cursor to the target by adjusting its position value. CONTROLS: Click green arrows to increase the value; click red arrows to decrease it. RULE: The value must land exactly on the target number within the limited action budget. TRAP: Assuming clicking empty spaces or decorations helps; they are harmless no-ops that waste time but not actions.

GOAL: Extend the green bar until it fully covers the target plus symbol. CONTROLS: Clicking the right glyph extends the bar; clicking the left retracts it. RULE: The bar length must increase by three units per click to align perfectly with the plus. TRAP: Stopping at the plus's center or near edge fails; you must extend to the far edge.

GOAL: Match each panel’s color grid to its legend. CONTROLS: Clicking a cell flips its color between red and blue. RULE: White marks in the legend indicate cells that must be red. TRAP: Assuming the legend updates to show remaining errors; it is a fixed target.

GOAL: Navigate the plug to the upper socket and align the connection pattern. CONTROLS: Arrows moved the plug; the button flipped the legend pattern to match the socket. RULE: The plug only connects when its path is clear and the legend matches the socket’s glyph. TRAP: Assuming the button only changed visuals; it actually altered passability or state, requiring precise timing.

GOAL: Move three distinct shapes to cover specific grid dots simultaneously. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the selected shape; Spacebar cycles selection to the next shape. RULE: All dots must be covered at the same time; covering them individually does not win. TRAP: Believing dots disappear when covered; they remain visible, requiring simultaneous coverage to finish.

GOAL: Place both yellow tokens into the two marked slots. CONTROLS: Click arrows to rotate specific loops of cells. RULE: Only tokens inside the rotated loop move; others stay put. TRAP: Assuming all colors interact; in reality, yellow positions depend solely on yellow locations, ignoring other colors.

GOAL: Move both squares to the opposite ends of the bridge. CONTROLS: Arrows move both squares at once; one follows the other. RULE: Pressing a direction moves every square in that direction simultaneously. TRAP: Thinking you can control squares independently to navigate around obstacles.

GOAL: Turn all grid blocks orange to match the target pattern. CONTROLS: Click a block to toggle its color between red and orange. RULE: Only click blocks that are currently the wrong color for the final state. TRAP: Mistaking background or legend markers for clickable blocks, causing wasted moves.

GOAL: Move a yellow block to the left bracket and an orange block to the right bracket by navigating two overlapping loops. CONTROLS: Click to rotate the left loop clockwise or counter-clockwise; click to rotate the right loop in either direction. RULE: The loops share two central slots, allowing blocks to cross from one path to the other. TRAP: Assuming the loops were independent or separate, missing that blocks could transfer between them at the shared points.

ESTROLISHED: The plug spawns at the top-left. A wire hangs in the upper-right corridor. The socket is at the bottom-right. FAILED: Moving the plug directly toward the socket without a ghost. GOAL IS NOT: Simply reaching the socket before the wire moves. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the plug. Space records a sequence, then rewinds time to replay it as a ghost while you move again.

GOAL: Move the plug to the wire to connect it. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the plug; Space records a ghost that replays your path. RULE: The ghost repeats your exact moves, allowing one plug to clear the path for the other. TRAP: Believing the ghost starts moving immediately. It spawns after recording, so timing your live moves relative to the ghost's start is critical.

GOAL: Assign colors to gray cells based on legend centers. CONTROLS: Click legends to cycle their gray cell color mapping. RULE: Gray maps to the color following the center in the cycle. TRAP: Assuming gray maps to the preceding color causes conflicts at overlaps.

GOAL: Move two pieces to specific target spots using two intersecting loops. CONTROLS: Click red arrows to shift loops backward; click green arrows to shift loops forward. RULE: Pieces transfer between horizontal and vertical loops only when passing through the four shared intersection points. TRAP: Believing each arrow click moves only one piece; actually, the entire loop shifts, moving all pieces on that track simultaneously.

GOAL: Fit six irregular shapes into a grid without overlap to fill the bottom bar. CONTROLS: Click a shape to select it; arrow keys move the selected shape one step. RULE: Pushing a shape into another causes the stationary shape to slide away in the same direction. TRAP: Assuming shapes block each other permanently; they can be displaced to clear paths.

ESTABLISHED: The cursor moves freely over blue, gray, and red tiles. A yellow target square exists inside a gray box structure. FAILED: Pressing podium buttons produced no visible change or path alteration. GOAL IS NOT: Simply activating the podium buttons, as they have no effect. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the cursor one tile per press; movement over colored tiles is safe so far.

GOAL: Align the plug's prongs with the wall sockets by moving it precisely into position. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the plug; each press shifts it three grid cells in that direction. RULE: Calculate exact steps by dividing the distance by three to avoid overshooting the target. TRAP: Assuming one key press equals one cell causes you to move too far and miss the connection.

GOAL: Rotate the red bar and solidify the blue path to reach the yellow target. CONTROLS: Arrows moved the green cursor; clicking podiums rotated bars or swapped blue states. RULE: The cursor needed a solid blue floor to cross the checkerboard gap safely. TRAP: Believing the checkerboard was walkable wasted time; only the solid blue state allowed passage.

GOAL: Rotate the plug to match the socket’s exact shape before the bar empties. CONTROLS: Arrows move the plug; pressing buttons rotates it clockwise; the plus button resets the pattern. RULE: The plug only fits when its footprint perfectly aligns with the socket’s hidden grid. TRAP: Assuming buttons respawn after use; they do not, so you must save enough moves for precise alignment.

GOAL: Match the grid pattern by toggling specific cells. CONTROLS: Click normal cells to flip them; click flippers to toggle themselves plus adjacent neighbors. RULE: Flippers affect multiple cells at once, while normal cells only affect themselves. TRAP: Believing flippers can be fixed individually; they cannot, so their parity dictates the entire solution.

GOAL: Move the cursor to the target anchor and swap positions. CONTROLS: Click empty space to move cursor; click anchor to swap. RULE: The map center determines the current location. TRAP: Assuming the sum of all pieces includes the cursor's new position is wrong; only anchors count toward the center.

GOAL: Slide the charcoal piece onto the yellow target outline. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the active piece; mouse clicks select different pieces. RULE: Only the charcoal piece fits the yellow shape; the black piece is a mirror image and cannot fit. TRAP: Believing the black piece could be rotated or flipped to fit the target wastes moves, as it is a fixed mirror shape.

GOAL: Determine the hidden color rotation path to match target patterns. CONTROLS: Click to shift all colors along the invisible loop. RULE: Colors move one step forward; track unique hues to map the cycle. TRAP: Assuming adjacent slots swap directly; they actually follow a long, non-local ring order.

GOAL: Align the plug with the target marker. CONTROLS: Click gates to shift the plug between mechanical arms. RULE: The plug preserves its relative offset within each arm's width. TRAP: Assuming the plug needs to touch the marker physically, rather than just sharing its row.

GOAL: Route the cursor to create a dynamic hub at the precise center of the three target zones. CONTROLS: Click empty cells to move the cursor; click adjacent nodes to swap their positions. RULE: The hub always forms at the midpoint between the cursor's current and previous anchor points. TRAP: Placing endpoints symmetrically around the hub is mandatory; asymmetric placement shifts the hub off-target.

GOAL: Align the black piece to mirror the charcoal target using the movable wall as the reflection axis. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active piece; clicking the wall or piece toggles which one responds to arrow keys. RULE: The black piece must be the exact horizontal mirror of the charcoal shape across the wall's vertical center line. TRAP: Assuming moving the wall pushes the black piece; they pass through each other, requiring you to click to switch control.

GOAL: Set four tiles to target states using minimal moves. CONTROLS: Arrows move cursor; Down cycles tile state. RULE: Learn color cycles to jump directly to targets, avoiding full sweeps. TRAP: Assuming all tiles share one cycle; they do not, so track states by color.

GOAL: Rotate three snowflake arms and swap one piece to align colored markers with target slots. CONTROLS: Red arrows rotate an arm’s outer ring; green arrows rotate its inner ring; the swap button exchanges two specific pieces. RULE: Each arm has independent rings; rotating one affects only that arm’s slots, letting you solve each marker separately. TRAP: Assuming all rings rotate together wastes moves; treat each snowflake’s layers as distinct controls to minimize clicks.

ESTABLISHED: The cup tumbles sequentially, pivoting on its own edges rather than a fixed point. FAILED: Attempting to move down from the current orientation was blocked by the block. GOAL IS NOT: Rotating around a single static center or simply sliding the cup horizontally. CONTROLS: Directional inputs trigger 45-degree tumbles, shifting the opening orientation and position accordingly.

ESTABLISHED: The boat sits in the lower pool, directly beneath a green block that stops its ascent. This block floats in water above the vessel. FAILED: Moving left or right does not bypass the block or raise the boat. Waiting does nothing. GOAL IS NOT: Reaching the water's surface in this lower section. CONTROLS: Clicking a floating green block destroys it, allowing the boat to rise through the cleared space.

GOAL: Paint the block purple then white using a tilting cup. CONTROLS: Arrow keys rotate the cup; Space pours ink; Click selects ink colors. RULE: Ink flows downward from the cup’s opening, filling empty space and coating surfaces it touches. TRAP: Assuming arrow keys move the cup positionally rather than rotating it, causing missed pours and wasted actions.

GOAL: Guide the floating boat to the pink plus sign at the surface. CONTROLS: Click blocks to shatter them; arrow keys slide the boat horizontally. RULE: Destroying a block opens adjacent water cells, creating a vertical channel for the boat to rise. TRAP: Assuming you can steer the boat vertically; you must clear obstacles to let buoyancy lift it automatically.

GOAL: Align two black shapes as reflections across a central line to match yellow templates. CONTROLS: Arrows moved pieces; clicks selected them. RULE: Shapes must mirror each other vertically across the axis. TRAP: Moving a piece down before shifting it left caused a collision with another piece.

GOAL: Guide the player safely through a grid filled with moving enemies. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move one square at a time. RULE: Enemies patrol fixed paths; time your moves to pass gaps safely. TRAP: Assuming enemies pause at the ends of their patrols wastes turns and causes collisions.

GOAL: Place both yellow blocks into their target slots. CONTROLS: Green moves shift blocks along horizontal and square loops; blue moves cycle three vertical slots. RULE: Moving a block out of a shared corner and back in changes its timing relative to other blocks in the loop. TRAP: Thinking you must keep every block inside its main loop; temporarily ejecting a block is the only way to adjust its position.

GOAL: Paint the block with three colors using the cup. CONTROLS: Arrows rotate the cup; clicks select paint; space pours. RULE: The cup only paints the side facing its opening. TRAP: Believing the pour spreads evenly; it actually paints only the specific diagonal half aligned with the cup's tilt.

GOAL: Navigate the maze grid to the exit while avoiding moving hazards. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player one step per turn. RULE: Obstacles bounce along fixed paths; time your moves to cross when they are away. TRAP: Assuming obstacles move in a straight line; they actually reverse direction at the ends of their tracks.

GOAL: Align the U-shape and bar over yellow targets by moving them separately to avoid merging. CONTROLS: Arrows shift the selected piece; clicks select the active piece. RULE: Move the U horizontally before lifting the bar, or move the bar before the U, to keep them disjoint until the final alignment. TRAP: Assuming overlap merges pieces permanently, causing unintended shared movement and wasted actions.

GOAL: Park the green shape into the ring while sliding the plus piece out of the way. CONTROLS: Arrows moved the active piece; moving into a passive piece pushed it across the grid. RULE: You could only push the plus if your shape fully overlapped its row or column. TRAP: Assuming you could push from the side; partial overlaps caused failed moves and wasted actions.

GOAL: Guide two separate blocks until they occupy the exact same square. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move both blocks simultaneously; the right block mirrors horizontal input. RULE: Perfect overlap wins, but ending up merely next to each other causes a fatal fusion. TRAP: Assuming you can step into the other block's current square; they cannot occupy the same space until the final winning move.

GOAL: Guide the player to the exit while avoiding the orange patrol that hides under red blocks. CONTROLS: Arrows move the player; stomping red blocks destroys them to clear paths. RULE: The orange enemy moves predictably along row ten, sometimes invisible when overlapping red cells. TRAP: Assuming hidden enemies are gone; they remain dangerous and block movement despite not appearing.

GOAL: Paint the grid into distinct colored zones using overlapping pours. CONTROLS: Arrows move the cursor, clicks select paint, space pours color. RULE: Each pour covers a geometric region, overwriting previous colors in that area. TRAP: Assuming pours are additive; they actually replace, so order matters to fix overlaps.

GOAL: The level required moving two walls to uncover a hidden target piece. CONTROLS: Arrows shifted the active object; clicks selected walls to make them active. RULE: Clicking a wall activates it, allowing arrow keys to slide it freely across the grid. TRAP: Assuming prong colors indicated solidity wasted time; prongs are transparent, showing the background color underneath.

GOAL: You must merge two separate groups by moving a single shared piece until the moving group's center aligns perfectly with the stationary one. CONTROLS: Click the moving piece to jump it to any empty spot, or click another piece in the moving group to swap positions with it. RULE: The group only merges when the mathematical average of the three moving pieces' positions exactly equals the target location. TRAP: Do not assume swapping pieces changes the group's center; swaps rearrange members but keep the average identical, wasting clicks.

GOAL: Fill four colored zones by tilting a cup to pour paint into a grid. CONTROLS: Arrow keys tilt the cup to change pour direction; spacebar pours the selected color. RULE: Each color covers a specific geometric region defined by its tilt angle and position. TRAP: Assuming the cup’s lid stays fixed; it moves with the tilt, changing where the paint exits.

GOAL: Route the plug to the socket by clearing the path through the wire grid. CONTROLS: Arrows move the plug; spacebar activates or releases the held wire end. RULE: Wires only stay pulled while the plug occupies their head position, requiring precise timing. TRAP: Assuming wire ends remain displaced after moving away, causing the path to close prematurely.

GOAL: Shrink the block, remove the wall, and enter the head. CONTROLS: Arrows move; mouse clicks form a diamond to shrink the piece. RULE: Clicking four points in a diamond pattern reduces the block’s size. TRAP: Clicking points in the wrong order fails to shrink the piece, wasting moves.

GOAL: Paint specific grid regions with four colors using a moving stencil and a final cap. CONTROLS: Arrows moved the stencil position; clicks selected colors or applied the final cap. RULE: Later pours overwrote earlier colors, so order determined the final pattern. TRAP: Assuming the first pour’s shape must exactly match its final color; it can be broader if covered later.

GOAL: Fit the T-shape and walls into the yellow outline to clear the level. CONTROLS: Arrows slide the active piece; clicks select pieces or toggle wall orientation. RULE: Walls must rotate to match the gap’s axis before sliding into place. TRAP: Assuming all commands execute instantly; timeouts can cause missing moves, forcing re-checks.

GOAL: Guide the green plug to the lowest band and the yellow plug to the top band. CONTROLS: Click bands to shrink their gray margins, forcing plugs into specific zones. RULE: A plug can only enter a band if that band's margin is small enough to fit it. TRAP: Targeting the middle band for the green plug is impossible; its minimum margin is too wide.

GOAL: Navigate to the goal by moving exactly four times. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move your character one space in the chosen direction. RULE: The path is clear; simply follow the open corridor without hesitation. TRAP: Do not assume walls are dynamic or that moves are blocked; the path is static and open.

ESTABLISHED: The nozzle requires a 20-width blue block at row 24, column 28. Two 12-width blocks must fill remaining gaps. The paint path is blocked by the current blue block at row 24, column 28. FAILED: Moving the 20-width block directly into position collides with the 12-width block currently occupying the target zone. Attempting to shift the blocking block without first changing its color causes a crash or rejection. GOAL IS NOT: Simply placing the 20-width block at the nozzle. The puzzle requires reconfiguring all three blocks to specific coordinates without overlapping the paint stream's

GOAL: Color the plus orange and the X green, then position them to cover matching dots. CONTROLS: Arrow keys moved shapes; SPACE toggled color or confirmed state; specific moves aligned shapes to targets. RULE: Each shape must end on a dot of its current color to complete the level. TRAP: Assuming paths could cross without affecting final positions; careful ordering prevented misalignment during movement.

GOAL: Align three liquid bars to pour into the target container. CONTROLS: Click a bar to select it, arrow keys to move, space to pour. RULE: Bars only stop moving when they hit a wall or another bar, not when they overlap. TRAP: Assuming bars pass through each other; they actually stack, so park blockers out of the way first.

GOAL: Guide the plug through two gates to align with the target marker. CONTROLS: Left and right buttons move the plug’s coordinates; clicking a gate swaps its region. RULE: Gates only open when the plug’s coordinates match specific values, locking the path. TRAP: Assuming the plug keeps its relative position when crossing a gate; it actually mirrors within the new region.

GOAL: Park three tokens on specific walls, then slide two active squares into one shared cell to merge and win. CONTROLS: Arrows move active entities; clicking a token selects it; clicking a square activates it. RULE: Only one entity moves per action; squares slide until hitting walls or other blocks. TRAP: Assuming clicks are instant; batching actions without verifying activation causes tokens to move instead of squares.

GOAL: Align two mirrored pieces behind hidden walls to clear the path. CONTROLS: Arrows move pieces or shift walls; clicks toggle wall orientation. RULE: Walls reflect positions, so moving a wall shifts the reflected piece opposite to the original. TRAP: Assuming walls are static barriers rather than movable mirrors that change piece coordinates via reflection.

GOAL: Guide the plus shape into the top target slot. CONTROLS: Arrows move the green block; pushing against the plus slides it. RULE: The plus passes through frame lines but stops when hitting solid walls. TRAP: Assuming the plus blocks all vertical movement; it actually slides through overlapping frame segments.

ESTABLISHED: Exiting the plus tile does not rotate the legend; a full re-entry is required to trigger the second press. FAILED: Attempting to leave the tile and proceed immediately without re-entering failed to rotate the legend to the solved state. GOAL IS NOT: A simple pass-through interaction where exiting completes the puzzle; the mechanism strictly requires repeated contact. CONTROLS: Moving away from the plus resets the trigger; moving back onto it registers the second press, rotating the legend to match.

GOAL: Rotate the legend to match the plug shape using limited energy, then carry the plug to the socket. CONTROLS: Arrows move you and consume energy. Entering a button tile rotates the legend. RULE: Energy drains on every move. You must arrive at the socket with zero energy remaining. TRAP: Exiting the button tile does not rotate the legend again; you must re-enter it to trigger the second rotation.

GOAL: Move the green block into the frame socket. CONTROLS: Arrows shift the block; the orange timer fills each step, resetting to red when full. RULE: A full reset forces the green block down, so time your moves between resets. TRAP: Assuming the timer is just decoration; ignoring its forced push wastes turns and misaligns the block.

GOAL: Navigate safely to the upper-left corner while evading a dormant red enemy. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player; the chaser pursues via pathfinding. RULE: The red enemy only activates if you approach its position too closely. TRAP: Ignoring the red’s wake-up range causes instant failure, even if the chaser is far.

ESTABLISHED: Pieces must mate via overlapping nubs; movement cost depends on current anchor positions, not just relative deltas. FAILED: Assuming mate cost equals relative delta distance; ignoring anchor alignment modulo three in feasibility checks. GOAL IS NOT: Simply minimizing relative shape displacement without accounting for absolute board constraints and lattice parity. CONTROLS: Rotate pieces to align nub shapes; translate pieces to satisfy modular anchor differences for valid mating.

GOAL: Slide four colored bars into their matching target slots without overlapping. CONTROLS: Click a bar to select it, then press arrow keys to move it one step. RULE: Bars only move in straight lines and stop when blocked by another bar or the edge. TRAP: Moving the long bar first traps the short ones; always clear the path for small pieces before shifting large obstacles.

GOAL: Move the X and ring to specific targets to reveal hidden white spots and color the ring red.
